segments.title: Thank you in Portuguese!
segments.say: Bia from Salvador, Brazil, wants to say thank you. Can you guess how?

segments.title: What does Bia say?
segments.say: What does Bia say? Careful, it's a tricky one! Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Bia says Obrigada!
segments.say: Obrigada! Girls and women say obrigada.

segments.title: The word follows you
segments.say: Boys and men say obrigado. The word matches the person saying it.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Did you guess right? Comment below, and follow for a new word.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
